One engine. Every layer of defence.

Modern attacks arrive from email, browsers, USB sticks and Wi-Fi alike. Aegis watches all of them at once — at home, at school and across your whole business network.

Real-time protection

Every file, download and attachment is checked the moment it appears — before it can run, not after the damage.

Anti-ransomware vault

Documents, photos and school records sit in a guarded vault. If anything tries to encrypt them, Aegis rolls it back.

Safe web & anti-phishing

Fake bank pages, prize scams and poisoned search results are flagged in the browser before you type a single password.

Firewall & home network scan

A two-way firewall plus a Wi-Fi audit that spots weak router passwords and strangers on your network.

Parental & classroom controls

Age-based content filters, screen-time schedules and app limits — set once from a single parent or teacher dashboard.

Zero slowdown promise

Cloud-assisted scanning keeps the heavy lifting off your machine. Games, lessons and video calls stay at full speed.

Threats don't sleep. Neither does the shield.

Aegis sensors in 90+ countries share every new attack signature worldwide within minutes — so a scam that appears in one city is already blocked in yours.

Questions, answered

Everything you need to know before you put the shield up.

Which devices does Aegis protect?+

Internet Security and Safe School cover Windows, macOS, Android and iOS under one licence — protect your laptop, phone and tablet together. Home Security covers Windows and macOS.

Will it slow my computer down?+

No. Aegis scans in the cloud wherever possible and pauses heavy work while you game, stream or present. In independent performance tests it used under 2% CPU during everyday tasks.

How does renewal work?+

Your licence renews automatically at the standard price so protection never lapses. We email you 30 days before renewal, and you can switch auto-renew off in one click from your account — no calls, no retention scripts.

What if Aegis misses a virus?+

Every paid plan carries our Virus Protection Promise: if a threat gets through while Aegis is installed and up to date, our experts remove it remotely for free — or we refund your subscription.

Can I get a refund?+

Yes. Every plan comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked. Contact support from your account page and the refund lands within 5–7 working days.

Do schools get special pricing?+

Safe School is priced per seat with volume tiers at 25 and 50 seats, and registered schools and charities get a further education discount. One licence can cover labs, staff laptops and student tablets.
